issues.description: The problem statement and the solution implementation refer to the distillation-circuit constructor as build_msd_circ(...), while the template repository defines a function named build_msd_circuit(...). This naming mismatch ("build_msd_circ" vs "build_msd_circuit") is for the same conceptual entity (the 15-to-1 MSD circuit builder) and will confuse students: they will look for the function the problem asks them to implement but find a differently named stub, and automated tests or graders expecting build_msd_circ may fail.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename the template function build_msd_circuit(...) to build_msd_circ(...) to match the problem statement and solution. Alternatively, keep build_msd_circuit(...) but add a small compatibility wrapper in the template: def build_msd_circ(*args, **kwargs): return build_msd_circuit(*args, **kwargs). This preserves pedagogical intent while removing the naming mismatch.
